template_policy: Preserve the selected original drwdot frame, zones, title block, fonts, arrows and projection. Read its actual usable bounds and reserved boxes; a reference drawing is composition evidence, not a replacement template.
scale_policy: Choose common scale by measured annotated-block occupation and balance, retain fixed font/arrow sizes, prefer 45%-65% filled usable area with 55% target; preserve approved frame.

bracket.support: side view or section through hidden geometry

provenance: Frame and visual hierarchy observed in the flange reference; plate/shaft/bracket routing is engineering inference and requires geometry-specific review.
final_layout_policy: Measure each fully dimensioned view envelope; translate aligned orthographic blocks together, reserve template regions, and stack measured tables at upper right.
